# Corpus

**Thesis, not settled doctrine** — Spencer's own framing when this was
proposed: an unproven idea for whether a single top-level "what
actually exists here" index is worth maintaining, distinct from
`DOCUMENTATION_POLICY.md` (which defines *types* and *rules*, not
inventory). Only exists in this repo and `.github` — not proposed
elsewhere yet, on purpose, until this proves useful.

## What's already auto-generated (don't duplicate here)

- [`docs/THESIS_INDEX.md`](docs/THESIS_INDEX.md) — every real `# Thesis`/`## Follow-up`
  doc under `hee/docs`, regenerated by `tools/hee-thesis-index.py`.
- `docs/history/PILL_INDEX.md` — same pattern, for Pills.

## The rest of what's real here

- **Root:** `README.md` (start here), `CONTRIBUTING.md` (governs
  `blueprints/` specifically), `CHANGELOG.md`.
- **`docs/`:** policy/reference docs — `DOCUMENTATION_POLICY.md` (the
  type taxonomy + cross-cutting rules), `HEE.md`, `HEE_POLICY.md`,
  `TROUBLESHOOTING.md`, `ROADMAP.md`, and more — not exhaustively
  listed here on purpose, see the directory itself.
- **`docs/guides/`:** operator-facing — `OPERATOR_GUIDE.md` (central,
  org-wide), `EXTERNAL_SURVEY_METHODOLOGY.md`, `GIT_GH_WORKFLOW.md`
  (agent git/gh safety rails, not an operator doc).
- **`blueprints/`:** authoritative doctrine, governed by
  `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- **`hee/cards/`, `hee/pills/`:** structured working notes — see
  `OPERATORS.md`'s cards-scanner entry for the real current inventory
  (mixed `kind: Card`/`kind: Pill`/plain docs/detached signatures,
  don't assume one schema).
- **`hee/contracts/`:** contract schema (live signed instances are in
  `fleet-ops`, not here).
- **`tooling/bin/`, `library/{bash,py,sh}`:** the actual scripts —
  see `OPERATORS.md`.

If this file drifts out of date faster than it's useful, that's the
thesis failing — say so and remove it rather than letting it become
another `[Insert the precise Purpose...]`-style lie.
